gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-graduate: Tilt Neon hums like bent glass tubing, with a splayed c and short ascenders. Graduate, a serif, leaves generous white between its letters and keeps stem and join the same, so extended text glides along without a snag.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-supreme: Big round bowls, loud and commanding: that's Bloody up top. Supreme brings crisp, heavy-looking text with letters held open, which gives the headline something solid to shout over.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-general-sans: Wide-set and expressive, Bushcraft shows no weight shift on any curve and barely lifts its capitals. General Sans then opens every bend wide, with a tall x-height that fills the line.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-manrope: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a raw, tactical look. While Capture Smallz hits hardest, Manrope is the approachable one, with bright curve openings and a line that holds one width.
gen-dafont-conthrax-satoshi: Wide-mouthed and geometric, Conthrax makes text feel like following a single thread, capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Satoshi, a sans with a soaring x-height, gives every stroke the same width and never squeezes its e shut.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-asap: Nasalization floats its letters well apart, each c opened like a pair of calipers. Asap brings open c arcs and a body height that nearly matches the capitals, giving the friendly heading a sturdy partner.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-fira-sans: Reading the body is smooth: s curves open wide at both ends and no thick-thin shift. Fira Sans, with its larger x-height, feels grounded and clean beside the glowing, pulled-apart letters of Neuropolitical.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-public-sans: Public Sans is hefty and trustworthy, with broad open counters. Nordic, powerful and ancient, spaces its letters like far-apart brush dabs, and at a small size those cramped openings would close up.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-supreme: Bent steel rod, tall-bodied and geometric: that's Conthrax. Supreme lays down a heavy-looking strip of crisp text with its letters held open, giving the geometric heading a solid floor to sit on.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-satoshi: Playful and commanding, Early GameBoy stretches its tracking wide, with a tempered thick-thin contrast that neither jolts nor flattens. Let Satoshi carry the text at a modest size, soaring and steady.
